name: PIRB
description: A comprehensive benchmark comparing Polish dense and hybrid text retrieval methods across standardized tasks and metrics.
reputation: A specialized benchmark in the Polish IR community with moderate adoption for evaluating dense vs. hybrid retrievers on Polish-language tasks.
notes: Language-specific (Polish) benchmark; non-LLM retrieval evaluation; common metrics depend on cutoff (k) so cross-work comparisons require consistent k; contamination risk if pretrained models used Polish web corpora overlapping with evaluation data.
